design: Targeted external follow-up chosen after the model results; not a prospective model benchmark. DICE selected by cell type and stimulation metadata before inspecting its QTL values.

queries.purpose: DICE resting CD4 total gene expression
DICE activated CD4 total gene expression
DICE classical monocyte PRKD2 expression; separate cohort check

rules: Preserve all returned rows, including non-significant and missing results.
Do not treat missing from the filtered cc file as biological absence or a null result.
Verify junction coordinate definitions against source code before matching to model junctions.
Align beta to ALT explicitly; never resolve strand by allele labels alone for palindromic variants.
Resting and activated samples are overlapping donors, not independent replication cohorts.
Dataset independence from published cohorts and model training must be audited separately.
Report p values as nominal; these targeted checks are not a new genome-wide discovery study.
